title: iberis pinnata var. crenata
intro: Iberis pinnata var. crenata, commonly known as Rock Candytuft, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in relieving digestive issues and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe skin irritations and coughs, making it a popular choice for treating colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of Rock Candytuft include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
